claim: For each confirmed Timeline and fixed binding plan, the current Explorer reports only closed horizon-free equivalence, replay-confirmed divergence, or an explicit non-decision/failure.
why_it_matters: This bounds the practical applicability of behavioral validation to generated JoI candidates.
minimum_convincing_evidence: Complete 388-case accounting with closure assertions for every positive and replay assertions for every divergence.
anti_claim: A bounded pass, failed replay, refusal, or omitted case is silently counted as equivalence.
falsifier: Any positive lacks closure/H=None evidence, any divergence lacks a confirmed replay, or any selected ID is absent or duplicated.
decision_if_unproven: Do not report certified-equivalent or detected-divergent counts; repair the harness and use a new run ID.
decision_rule: Artifact validity is required independently of the numerical outcome; all failures remain in the total denominator.
loss_contract: Statuses are EQUIV-FIXPOINT, DIVERGE_CONFIRMED, REFUSED, GENERATION_ERROR, PREPARATION_ERROR, INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN, REPLAY_UNCONFIRMED, TIMEOUT, MEMORY_LIMIT, CRASH, or HARNESS_ERROR.
falsification_test: Recompute counts from JSONL, verify unique/complete IDs and digests, then assert closure/H=None and confirmed replay invariants.
selection_history: All 388 dataset rows were used in prior development and candidate outcomes are visible.
All fixed Gemma-v3 candidate bytes are retained; no post-outcome case removal.
predecessor_failures: Historical E3 used H=32 and cannot certify horizon-free equivalence.
The Gemma endpoint was unavailable on 2026-09-15, preventing fresh generation.
